text:
ravi_eng: Heads up, a recent commit to model-switcher added a short-lived race causing 502s on some tokenization requests in ap-south1. I have a minimal hotfix: debounce the switch and fall back to previous tokenizer if mismatch detected. Image: `redwood/model-switcher:2026-03-23-hotfix-c`. Need expedited approval for a quick window.
maria_release: Paste the rollout + rollback plan and smoke criteria. Need one SRE + release lead ack.
ravi_eng: Rollout: canary 2% -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (15m). Rollback: redeploy `redwood/model-switcher:2026-03-15-prod` and traffic-pin. Smoke: end-to-end tokenization check, p99 < 800ms, no new 5xx in canary. Staging smoke looked good: `token_ok=true p99=430ms`.
lee_sre: Happy to run prod shadow smoke. Doing it now, ETA 4m.
tim_oncall: Also confirm no secret reloads required for dedicated pools.
ravi_eng: No secret changes. We'll set `dedicated_autoupdate=false` and pin image during window.
releasebot: deploy request: promote redwood/model-switcher:2026-03-23-hotfix-c -> ap-south1-switch-canary. Window: immediate, 40m.
deploybot: initiating canary (2%) in ap-south1.
lee_sre: Shadow smoke: token_ok=true p99=450ms, no errors. +1 SRE.
maria_release: +1 release lead. Preparing release note: "hotfix(model-switcher): debounce switch to avoid tokenization 502s; pinned during window."
deploybot: increasing canary to 10%
ravi_eng: Observability: 5xx decreased in canary, no regression on latency.
lee_sre: 10% stable for 9m. ok to ramp to 50%.
deploybot: ramping to 50%
maria_release: Approving full roll after 50% steady for 10m.
deploybot: shifting to 100% over next 5m
releasebot: applying image pin to dedicated pools and toggling autoupdate off.
 deploybot: rollout complete: model-switcher `2026-03-23-hotfix-c` at 100% ap-south1. Health checks green.
tim_oncall: Leaving pin for 12h, monitoring for 2h.
lee_sre: I'll keep an eye on alerts for 3h. artifacts: https://internal.redwood/ci/artifacts/1923456789
maria_release: Publishing release note and tagging support. Closing thread.
ravi_eng: Thanks all. No rollback required. closing. :shipit:
